notes: 10 stills for the Ashwatthama film: P01 title card + P02-P09 story beats (p1-p8) + P10 end card. All AI-generated dark illustrations for a mythology-horror story, not evidence of a real event (skill rule 7).

Photos live in the project folder (photos/p1..p8.jpg) — NOT in assets/gold (that bank holds the Golu pictures; never overwrite it). At render time the workflow's 'Stage story photos' step must be replaced (see render-photo-stage.patch) to copy p1..p8.jpg -> assets/photos/k1..k8.jpg and title.jpg/end.jpg -> assets/photos/title.jpg + moral.jpg.
p2/p7 were portrait originals, cropped to 16:9 (p2 y 350-980, p7 y 250-970) and verified by eye after cropping.
